title: The Aptoide Games store will be available to download from the Google Play Store
description: Aptoide has just announced that Aptoide Games, its specialized games app store, has been approved for distribution on Google Play in the US, following Google's defeat in Epic Games' lawsuit against it. Part of the ruling in that case forced Google to allow third-party app stores on Google Play, and then Google's settlement with Epic Games resulted in what Google calls the Third-party App Store on Play Program. Aptoide Games on Google Play This is what Aptoide Games is taking advantage of, and it may very well be the first third-party app store that will be available on Google...

title: The iPhone 18 Pro Max's actual battery leaks, here's how big it is
description: The iPhone 18 Pro Max is launching next month alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra. Back in early July, we first heard that the iPhone 18 Pro Max's battery capacity would be 5,425 mAh for the eSIM model, and 5,235 mAh for the one with a physical SIM card. Then, mere days later, we heard that the former would be 5,567 mAh, and the latter 5,391 mAh. Today three images purportedly showing the iPhone 18 Pro Max's actual battery have been leaked in China, and one of them clearly shows a capacity of 5,391 mAh. That matches the earlier rumor, and it fits because China should be getting...

title: Verizon's latest outage saw mobile and internet services disrupted in Southern California
description: Verizon hasn't had a great day, to say the least. The carrier has announced that vandals cut multiple fiber cables, causing service disruptions for both mobile and internet customers in parts of Southern California. Repairs were swiftly initiated, and the service was restored within a few hours. Law enforcement was notified and is investigating the incident. Theft and vandalism like this, Verizon says, "represent a direct threat to the safety and security of our communities". The company is "committed to raising awareness and driving proactive solutions to prevent these direct...

title: iPhone 18 Pro BOM cost estimated to be up by 40%
description: We’ve already seen rumors that iPhone 18 Pro availability may be limited at launch due to the ongoing global memory chip shortage and a new TrendForce report now gives an estimate of how much more expensive the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro might end up being. The iPhone 18 Pro’s bill of materials (BOM) is expected to rise by up to 38% compared to its predecessor. This is for the 256GB storage version. As TrendForce puts it, higher retail prices for the iPhone 18 Pro are “unavoidable” at this point. Previous estimates suggest the baseline 256GB iPhone 18 Pro will cost as much as...

title: You can now use Venmo to pay for apps and subscriptions on Google Play
description: In the US, you can now pay for stuff on Google Play - apps, games, subscriptions, in-app purchases, etc. - using your Venmo balance or the cards and bank accounts linked to your Venmo account. Of course, before you can use this, you need to set it up in Google Play, linking your Venmo account to your Play account, by going to the Payment methods section in the Google Play Store app. Once that's done, you're good to go. Venmo is merely the latest payment method that Google Play has added, following the likes of PayPal and Cash App. Google thus seems adamant about diversifying its...

title: Leaked images show off the Fairphone 6+ in Cobalt Blue
description: A few weeks ago, a new version of the Fairphone 6 surfaced – dubbed the “Fairphone 6+”, the new model was listed with 12GB of RAM and 256GB storage. That is more than the original model, which only has 8 gigs of RAM. This is quite an unexpected move given everything that has been going on in the world of semiconductors. Anyway, the listing was spotted by NieuweMobiel and showed three color options: Cobalt Blue, Horizon Black and Forest Green. Now the Dutch publication also has images that show off the first color: Fairphone 6+ in Cobalt Blue More specifically, these leaked images...

title: Report: Samsung is increasing the Galaxy Z Fold8 production target for this year by 1 million units
description: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 has proven to be more successful than even Samsung dared to hope. According to ETNews, the company’s initial production batch already favored the new wide foldable – Samsung had planned to build 2.8 million Z Fold8 units this year, plus 2.0 million Z Fold8 Ultra units and 1.5 million Z Flip8 units. However, now the Korean publication is reporting that Samsung is increasing the Z Fold8 production target by 1 million units for close to 4 million units total in 2026. title: The Google Pixel Watch 5 will come in a Stephen Curry edition
description: The Google Pixel Watch 5 is expected to launch in just under two weeks on August 20, if the time on the leaked images is an indication. The announcement event, on the other hand, is in two days, which will reveal the Pixel 11 series as well. As usual, all the leaks leading up to the actual release are so revealing that they leave nothing to the imagination. After the tipsters exhausted pretty much all the info regarding specs and design, we are now getting renders and pricing of the special Stephen Curry edition as well. title: The Galaxy Z Fold8 braves sand, blades and Zack himself in JerryRigEverything's durability test
description: If you see someone pouring sand and grit over a brand new Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, there is a better than 50% chance that their name is Zack. This is part of the standard durability test of the JerryRigEverything channel, as is the bend test. For the Z8 generation, Samsung introduced the Flex Titanium screen design, which combines an aluminum plate with a titanium alloy film to strengthen the folding OLED display inside the Galaxy Z Fold8 and the Z Fold8 Ultra (the Z Flip8 missed out on this upgrade). title: Third-generation foldable iPhone said to feature larger displays
description: Apple is yet to unveil its first foldable iPhone, but a new report claims the company is already planning its second- and third-generation successors. Apple's first foldable, rumored to be called the iPhone Ultra, is expected to debut this September. In the latest edition of his Power On newsletter, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman claims that Apple is already planning a second-gen foldable iPhone for 2027. The report echoes an earlier rumor from June, which claimed the second-gen model would retain the same design as its predecessor. Gurman also says Apple has begun development of a...

title: Lava Smart 4 announced with specs that sound straight out of 2016
description: Earlier this summer, Lava launched its Smart 4 Plus smartphone featuring a pretty mediocre spec sheet, and the brand has now announced an even more affordable entry with the Lava Smart 4. Lava Smart 4 It retails for INR 8,500 ($90), but it also brings specs that showcase just how severe the global memory shortage is hitting entry-level devices. Let’s start with the display. Lava Smart 4 brings a 6.56-inch LCD with 960 x 540 px resolution. That’s a 540p display with 168ppi in 2026. description: REDMAGIC introduced the industry’s first mass-produced smartphone with a liquid cooling system, the REDMAGIC 11 Pro, a few months ago. Now the company is bringing this technology to gaming tablets with its most powerful slate yet. The REDMAGIC Astra 2 will go on open sale globally on August 26. title: Moto G Max is coming to India with a Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 and 7,000mAh battery
description: Motorola launched the Moto G Max in select global markets back in June. The smartphone is now headed to India with a different set of specifications. The Moto G Max will debut in India on August 14 and will be available for purchase via the official company website and Flipkart. It will be powered by the Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 chipset, which will be paired with 6GB of LPDDR5X RAM and 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. title: Redmi 17 5G and Redmi 17 4G go official
description: Following the Redmi 15 series from last year, Xiaomi has now launched its Redmi 17 series with two members. The Redmi 17 4G and Redmi 17 5G share identical looks and key specs. Redmi 17 4G (left) and Redmi 17 5G (right) Both phones come with 6.9-inch IPS LCDs, but unlike their predecessors, the new models feature 1600 x 720px resolution panels instead of the FHD ones found on their predecessors. title: iQOO Neo11 Ultra and Z11s to launch next week, design revealed
description: iQOO has confirmed the launch date of the Neo11 Ultra and Z11s in China. The company has also revealed the design of both smartphones along with several of their key specifications. The iQOO Neo11 Ultra and iQOO Z11s will debut in China on August 18, the company confirmed in a Weibo post. While the Neo11 Ultra is being marketed as the only smartphone in its segment to combine a 2K display with a 9,100mAh battery, the Z11s is being touted as the company's first phone with a 10,000mAh battery. description: Apple is reportedly exploring a revamped smartwatch lineup with new designs, form factors, and even a screenless fitness tracker. description: Asus has new laptops coming out in time for IFA next month, and we get to see one of them in quite a few alleged renders that appear to have likely been upscaled using AI and kind of messed up in the process. description: Xiaomi revealed the Redmi K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max ahead of their August 11 launch. description: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy S23, Galaxy S23+, and Galaxy S23 Ultra in February 2023 with Android 13-based One UI 5.1, and later in October, the brand introduced the Galaxy S23 FE with the same OS. title: Weekly poll: do you use a feature phone? Why?
description: Feature phones are making a comeback – is this just a fad (like Gen Z folks running around with point-and-shoot cameras) or is this a genuine trend on the market, a pushback against the all-capable, all-consuming smartphone? Now, the term “feature phone” was never clearly defined and is even murkier now. So to be clear as to what we mean, we mean phones that deliberately restrict their own capabilities.
